- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
Code: lines 4496-4506 (reconcile_tracking_body_after_security_pass_transition function)
Problem: The function still contains an early return guard that prevents re-rendering when both integration_branch and final_merge_pr are empty, despite the commit message claiming it was removed.
Why it fails at runtime: When security_pass_fail_closed runs with no integration branch (e.g., "no integration branch to audit"), the function returns immediately without calling reconcile_tracking_issue_body_from_state, leaving the tracking body's security-pass block stale and showing the previous clean pass status even though the state has changed to failed.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
Code: lines 5057-5062 (SECURITY_PASS_CLEAN path inside run_security_pass_inline)
Problem: The clean-pass path updates security_pass_status to "passed", sets security_pass_head_sha, changes status to "in_progress", and calls post_state_comment but does not call reconcile_tracking_body_after_security_pass_transition.
Why it fails at runtime: After a clean audit, the tracking issue body can show a stale security-pass block (Status: passed with old SHA) while the state comment shows the new pending state, creating a mismatch between what the issue body displays and the actual state.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
